race.comment: Good race for the Apache Cat Classic. BUSTLING (7) hasn't lived up to the early hype as a 2yo in Perth but he was racing consistently last time in, brave under 62kg first up last campaign over 1000m at Caulfield before proving competitive in stakes company. This looks a nice race for him off a short break. NDOLA (1) is racing very well this time in. He was dropping back to 1100m at Caulfield last time and charged home, missing by the barest of margins on the line. Much prefer him back up to 1200m, he'll be very hard to hold out. LA FRACAS (6) resumes. He didn't win last time in but is talented on his day, any give in the track would be helpful. BEHAVIOUR (12) continues to race very well and should be thereabouts. PIASTRI (10) is a consistent sprinter and won at his first go for the new yard.
